name: Stepwise Enquiry
author: zievy

sections.description:
Turn a long, off-putting form into a few easy steps, and keep every lead where you can see it.

Stepwise Enquiry lets a plumber, a dog groomer, a cleaner or any small business ask the right questions in the right order. Visitors answer one short step at a time. You get a tidy lead list in your own dashboard.

Multi-step forms, conditional questions and a lead list are all included, free. Everything is free. Nothing is locked.

What you get

  • Multi-step forms. Break an enquiry or quote request into steps so it feels quick to fill in.
  • Conditional questions. Show or skip a step, or a single question, depending on an earlier answer. A customer who needs an emergency call-out sees different questions from one who wants a booking next month.
  • Five question types. Choice, text, number, email and phone.
  • As many forms as you need. Each form has its own shortcode and its own block, so a form for each of your services is simply more forms.
  • A lead list in your dashboard. Every enquiry is saved on your own site. Open the list, then open any lead to see every answer, and download the lot as a CSV.
  • An email for each new lead. Set one notification address and you hear about enquiries as they arrive.
  • Spam protection built in. A hidden field, a signed time token and a rate limit. No captcha, no outside service, no account to set up.
  • Looks after personal data. Choose how long leads are kept and old ones are tidied away daily. It works with the personal data export and erase tools in WordPress, and removes its data cleanly when you delete it.
  • Private by design. Stepwise Enquiry does not contact any outside service, does not phone home and does not track your visitors. The only message it ever sends is your notification email.
  • Translation ready. Every word the plugin shows can be translated.

Who it is for

Small businesses and the people who build sites for them: trades, groomers, cleaners, tutors, photographers and anyone who needs to know a little about a job before they quote.

Help and support

Help is on zievy.com. Start with the FAQs; if they do not answer it, use the support form. Free support: a reply within 7 working days.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the stepwise-enquiry folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Go to Stepwise Enquiry, Forms, and add your first form. A starter form is there to edit.
  4. Put it on a page with its shortcode, for example [stepwise_enquiry id="1"], or with the Stepwise Enquiry block.
  5. Set the notification email and how long to keep leads under Stepwise Enquiry, Settings.
sections.faq:
Is it really free?

Yes. Multi-step forms, conditional questions, the lead list and the CSV download are all in the plugin you download here. Nothing is locked behind a payment.

How do I put a form on a page?

Create a form under Stepwise Enquiry, Forms, then add it to any page or post with the Stepwise Enquiry block, or paste its shortcode. You can place the same form in more than one place.

Can I ask different questions depending on an answer?

Yes. Any step or question can be set to show only if an earlier answer matches.

Where do the enquiries go?

They are saved in your own site’s database and listed under Stepwise Enquiry, Leads, where you can open any one or download them all as a CSV. You also get one email for each new enquiry, sent to the address you choose in the settings.

Does it use a captcha or load anything from another site?

No captcha, and nothing is loaded from another site. Each form carries a hidden field and a signed time token, and the number of submissions from one address is limited. Every script and style is included in the plugin and served from your own site.

What exactly is stored?

For each lead: the form it came from, the time, the answers given, and the name, email address and phone number where the form asks for them. The visitor’s IP address is not stored with the lead. It is used only for the rate limit, as a salted hash that expires within a day. The plugin sets no cookie.

How long are leads kept?

For the number of days you set under Settings (365 by default). Once a day, older leads are deleted. Set 0 to keep leads until you delete them yourself.

Can I export or erase one person’s data?

Yes. The plugin works with the personal data export and erase tools under Tools. It finds leads by the email address the person gave, so give the form an email question. Leads with no email address can be deleted by hand from the lead list. You are the one responsible for the details you collect, so tell visitors what you do with them in your own privacy notice.

What happens to my data if I delete the plugin?

Deleting the plugin from the Plugins screen removes its forms, leads, settings and scheduled task. Deactivating it keeps your data.

My site uses full page caching. Will forms still work?

Yes. Each form carries a security nonce, which WordPress expires after 12 to 24 hours, so set your cache to refresh pages that contain a form at least every 12 hours. If a cached page is older than that, the visitor is asked to reload.
